d: The Bombay High Court at Goa has directed the Election Commission of India to restore the names of six members of a family who were deleted from the electoral rolls during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR). The family, which had shifted houses within the same Santa Cruz Assembly constituency, had submitted Form 8 applications to update their addresses. However, their applications were rejected after the ECI's ERONET system was frozen during the enumeration period.
